english.note: Use 功夫 when you specifically mean Chinese kung fu or martial-arts skill, rather than a named non-Chinese discipline.

exampleSentences.english: I learned a Chinese martial art from Master Lee when I was young, and I still practise every day.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我細個跟李師傅學過功夫，依家仲日日練。
